focus_areas: Texture realism of the terry cloth loops.
Coherence of the printed pattern on the pocket.
Physical attachment of the pocket to the main body.
Definition of the neck hole boundary.
Absence of hallucinated fasteners on the front surface.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interface between the yellow patterned pocket and the white terry cloth body. Does the pattern look like it is printed on fabric, or does it look like a digital overlay? Check the neck hole for any signs of melting into the background. Crucially, verify that there are NO ties or snaps visible on the front of the bib, as these should be on the back.
image_description: A close-up view of a baby bib made of white terry cloth with a yellow and white floral patterned pocket attached to the lower front. The bib has a rounded neck hole and a curved top edge, hanging against a solid pale yellow background.
